name: Intloko kunye ne-migraine
tagline: Uninzi alunabungozi. Abanye banjalo. Yazi imiqondiso.

urgent.heading: Yiya esibhedlele ngoku ukuba
urgent.primary_message: Uninzi lweentloko aziyingozi. Kodwa iimpawu ezithile ezilumkisayo zinokuthetha ukubetha, ukopha kwengqondo, okanye i-meningitis. Musa ukulinda - hamba.

Intloko ebuhlungu kunye nomkhuhlane kunye nentamo eqinile okanye i-rash

Intloko emva kokulimala entloko, ngakumbi ngokugabha okanye ukozela
Intloko entsha ekuvusa ebuthongweni, okanye iba mandundu xa ugoba okanye ulele phantsi

Intloko ebuhlungu ngokuxhuzula, ukulahlekelwa ngumbono, okanye ukulahlekelwa yingqondo

what_is_it.heading: Intloko kunye ne-migraine ngokwemiqathango ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Uninzi lweentloko ziintloko ezixineneyo-ezibangelwa zizihlunu eziqinileyo, uxinzelelo, ukuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni, okanye ukungalali kakuhle. I-Migraine yahlukile-imeko ye-neurological apho ingqondo iba yi-hypersensitive, kaninzi kunye neentlungu ezibuhlungu, isicaphucaphu, kunye novakalelo ekukhanyeni kunye nesandi.
paragraphs: Iintloko ezibuhlungu zivakala ngathi zibambene entloko, macala omabini, zibuthuntu kwaye azipheli. I-Migraines idla ngokubetha kwicala elinye, igqibe iiyure ezi-4-72, kwaye ikunyanzele ukuba ulale phantsi kwigumbi elimnyama. Iintloko zeCluster zinqabile - ziqatha, zimfutshane, zijikeleze iliso elinye.

Uninzi lweentloko zixazulula ngokuphumla, ulwelo, kunye neentlungu ezilula. Iintloko ezihlala qho okanye eziqatha zifuna ugqirha - hayi ukufumana ithumba (ezi zinqabile) kodwa ukufumana unyango olungcono kunolo unalo ngoku. I-Migraine ingakumbi inonyango oluninzi olusebenzayo abantu abangalwaziyo.

items.headline: Ixhaphake kakhulu
items.body: Malunga ne-12% yabemi boMzantsi Afrika bane-migraine. Iintloko ezibuhlungu zichaphazela phantse wonke umntu ngamaxesha athile.

items.headline: Iyanyangeka
items.body: I-Migraine inonyango olusebenzayo - zombini ukumisa ukuhlaselwa kunye nokuthintela. Ukuba eyakho ayilawulwa kakuhle, kukho iinketho ezingcono.

items.headline: Ukusetyenziswa kakhulu kwePainkiller
items.body: Ukuthatha i-painkillers ezilula ngaphezu kweentsuku ezi-2-3 ngeveki ngokwenene kunokubangela intloko ebuhlungu. Thetha nogqirha malunga nale nto - eqhelekileyo kwaye iyanyangeka.

items.headline: Ubukhulu becala ayikho serious
items.body: Amathumba ebuchotsheni kunye nezizathu ezinzulu zinqabile. Iiflegi ezibomvu ngasentla ziphawula xa kufuneka ukhathazeke - kuyo yonke enye into, isoloko ilungile.

pull_quote.text: I-migraine 'ayisiyontloko nje embi'. Sisiganeko semithambo-luvo esinokushiya umntu engakwazi ukusebenza, ukuqhuba, okanye ukunyamekela abantwana iiyure okanye iintsuku. Ifuna unyango lokwenene.

signs.heading: Ebaxelela bahlukane
signs.lede: Iintloko ezahlukeneyo ziphendula kunyango olwahlukileyo - ukuchonga olwakho kukunceda ulunyange.

items.title: Uxinzelelo lwentloko
items.description: Ibhanti eqinileyo ejikeleze intloko, macala omabini, ibuthuntu kwaye izinzile. Iphakathi ukuya phakathi. Akukho sicaphucaphu. Ngokufuthi ngenxa yoxinezeleko, ukungalali kakuhle, ukuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni, ukutsala nzima kwamehlo, okanye imeko embi.

items.title: I-Migraine
items.description: Iintlungu ezibetha rhoqo kwicala elinye, ziphakathi ukuya kumandundu. Kumaxesha amaninzi kukho isicaphucaphu, ukugabha, ukukhanya kunye novakalelo lwesandi. Ihlala iiyure ezingama-4-72. Isenokulandela i-visual aura (i-zigzags, indawo eyimfama).

items.title: Intloko yeCluster
items.description: Ngesiquphe, iintlungu ezinzima, zokomba ezijikeleze iliso elinye. Ukunkcenkceshela kwamehlo, ukuxinana kweempumlo kwicala elinye. Ngokufutshane (i-15 min - iiyure ze-3) kodwa uhlaselo oluninzi ngosuku kwiiveki. Ifuna unyango lwengcali.

items.fact: I-Migraine yimeko ye-neurological ebandakanya utshintsho kumsebenzi wombane wengqondo, ukuhamba kwegazi kunye nokuvuvukala. Intloko ebuhlungu yolunye uphawu lwabaninzi. Ifanele ukuthathelwa ingqalelo.

items.myth: Ukuba iipilisi zentlungu azincedi, akukho nto iya kwenza.
items.fact: I-Migraine-specific treatments-triptans, gepants, kunye nezinye-zisebenza xa iintlungu eziqhelekileyo zingasebenzi. Amayeza okuthintela anokunqumla i-migraine frequency kwisiqingatha. Buza ugqirha wakho.

Amathumba ebuchotsheni anqabile kwaye ngokuqhelekileyo abangela iipatheni ezithile - zimbi kakhulu kusasa, ukuhlanza, iimpawu ze-neurological. Uninzi lweentloko ezihlala zihleli zi-migraine, uxinzelelo, okanye ukusebenzisa kakhulu amayeza - hayi ithumba.
I-Migraine ichaphazela abantu bazo zonke izini. Ukungayinaki akuyenzi imithambo-luvo ingaphantsi. Unyango lukhona - ukulusebenzisa kunengqiqo, alukho buthathaka.

items.title: Ngentloko ebuhlungu ngamaxesha athile
items.description: Paracetamol okanye ibuprofen njengoko kuyalelwe. Hydrate. Phumla kwigumbi elizolileyo, elimfiliba. Izinto ezibangela idilesi-ubuthongo, ixesha lesikrini, uxinzelelo, uxinzelelo lwamehlo.

items.title: Nge-migraine - yenza kwangoko
items.description: Thatha isiqabu kwiintlungu kwaye uphumle ngokukhawuleza xa ubona i-migraine iqala. I-Triptans (sumatriptan) isebenza ngcono kakhulu kuphawu lokuqala kunokuba intlungu iphezulu. Thetha neklinikhi malunga nokukhethwa kwamayeza kagqirha.

items.title: Gcina idayari yentloko
items.description: Umhla, ixesha, uhlobo, ubukhali, yintoni encedileyo, izinto ezinokubangela ukuba kwenzeke. Iinyanga ezimbini zamanqaku ziya kubonisa iipateni. Zisa idayari kugqirha-iluncedo kakhulu kunokuchaza ngokusuka kwinkumbulo.

items.title: Ukuba uthatha iipilisi zeentlungu iintsuku ezininzi - bonana nogqirha
items.description: I-Painkiller-overuse headache ixhaphakile kwaye ibuyiselwa umva. Ngokuchaseneyo, unyango kukumisa i-painkiller. Ugqirha unokukunceda ukuba wenze oku ngokukhuselekileyo.

items.title: Ukuba iiflegi ezibomvu zivela - yiya esibhedlele
items.description: Intloko ebuhlungu ngesiquphe, intloko ebuhlungu enomkhuhlane/ukuqina kwentamo/irhashalala, intloko ebuhlungu ngokubhideka okanye ubuthathaka — ezi zinto zifuna uvavanyo olukhawulezileyo.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Uninzi lweentloko ezibuhlungu zinokulawuleka kwinqanaba lasekliniki. Inzuzo eqhubekayo ye-migraine evela kwi-neurology referral - ekhoyo ngenkqubo yoluntu.

helplines.description: Ngentloko yokuduma, intloko ebuhlungu eneempawu zemithambo-luvo

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Uvavanyo lwamahhala, i-painkillers, kunye nomyalelo we-migraine

helplines.description: Kwi-counter-the-counter paracetamol kunye ne-ibuprofen ukuze zisetyenziswe ngamaxesha athile
